My private value is $28. In a first-price sealed bid auction with three bidders, I want to bid strategically. Since values are randomly drawn and independent, I'll aim to bid slightly below my true value to maximize potential profit. A bid around $25 gives me some buffer - if others bid lower, I'm likely to win, and if they bid higher, I avoid overpaying. This balanced approach protects against both overbidding and underbidding.
